sections.headline: Modern Kidney & Bladder Wellness May Be Falling Short
sections.body: Today's processed foods, chronic stress, and environmental toxins can burden the body's natural urinary balance. Many people aren't getting enough of the plant compounds — beta-sitosterol, zinc, and omega fatty acids — that the kidneys and bladder depend on to stay calm and resilient. When these reserves run low, the effects ripple outward: urinary urgency, disrupted sleep, thinning hair, low energy, and brain fog. These aren't separate problems. They're one interconnected imbalance rooted in a nutritional gap most people never know to address.

sections.headline: The Ancient Seed Backed by Centuries of Use

Lumora uses 3,000mg of cold-pressed pumpkin seed oil — preserving the full spectrum of beta-sitosterol and omega fatty acids that low-heat or synthetic alternatives lose in processing.
